title: Explorer C Gloss Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tuned for all-terrain exploration, the LS2 Explorer C Gloss Black is engineered for uncompromised dual-sport versatility across gravel, sand, and asphalt across highway asphalt and backcountry gravel. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1320g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~89 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Carbon adventure with removable peak, Pinlock, and speaker pockets.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for adventure riding with a slightly raised visor and integrated sun shield; fits most head shapes but may feel tight on very large heads due to the dual-sport shell design.

technical_analysis: Features Kinetic Polymer Alloy (KPA) / HPFC High Performance Fiberglass Composite shell construction paired with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield. The interior utilizes Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the LS2 Explorer C Gloss Black: combining Spain / China 🇪🇸🇨🇳 craftsmanship with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield and Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: LS2 Explorer C Gloss Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the LS2 Explorer C Gloss Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in LS2's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the Explorer C Gloss Black brings Spanish engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The LS2 Explorer C Gloss Black represents LS2's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~89 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the LS2 Explorer C Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
